name: Orochi Samurai
headerMeta: Golden era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 295 leadership · Seasonal unit · T5
pitch: A high-minimum-damage skirmisher that punches through armor and disarms on every hit, but folds once both abilities are on cooldown against anything with stun or daze. Master the 1→2 combo to bypass its animation weakness and one-shot isolated heroes.

doctrines.name: Brace Doctrines
doctrines.note: only affect F1/F2/F3 formation brace — Orochi never uses one

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Consistent results — the 2 ability gets three quick attacks, can proc parry, has some block break, and deals very high minimum damage.

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Snowballs better in blob fights, but the 1 ability is slower with minimal block capability and less block break.

battleRole.positioning: Pair with Chaindart or any lock-ult hero class {1}. Look for isolated targets to catch with a hero-diving one-shot rather than committing to the front of a blob {1}.
battleRole.tips: If ability 1 is on cooldown and only 2 is up, only engage where the enemy lacks stun/daze — otherwise avoid the blob fight entirely {1}. Ability 1 (Piercing Strike) phases through enemy units regardless of type, letting ability 2 (Storm Pound) land and maximize DPS from inside the formation {1}. Ability 2 has a short activation range and can whiff if the unit is dazed, perma-stunned, or knocked down right as it triggers {1}. Neither ability cleanses existing CC {1}.

cards.name: Block units
cards.why: Orochi lacks block itself and struggles to get damage through

cards.name: High-mobility / dodge units
cards.why: kite and avoid its short-range 2 ability window

matchups.pressure: You pressure: units with high damage reduction such as Spartan Chosen and Iron Reapers — Orochi's high minimum damage cuts through their damage reduction {1}. Also beats Sipahis badly, cited by name as one of the high-damage, low-speed anti-cav units that punish it hardest {2}.

controls.notes: 1→2 combo: use ability 1, then trigger ability 2 right before the second strike of 1 lands — this makes 2 CC-immune for the rest of 1's duration, ensuring the hit lands even through stun/daze; pull out and repeat {1}. Ability 1 (Piercing Strike) has speed modifiers that deal significant damage to charging units {1}. Ability 2 (Storm Pound) blocks and procs the parry passive, with block that regenerates quickly — similar to Zweihander's 2 ability {1}. Both abilities carry a disarm effect that prevents enemy attacks for a set duration; if disarm lands mid-animation, only the next animation is halted {1}.
